parsed.name: NI-DAQ任务等待线程
parsed.description: 用于实验控制流程中的非物理软件组件。它以线程方式连接任务对象、运行等待逻辑并执行关闭操作，适合配合 NI-DAQ 相关任务的异步执行与生命周期管理。
parsed.description_en: A non-physical software component used in laboratory control workflows. It runs as a thread to attach to a task object, execute waiting logic, and handle closure, supporting asynchronous execution and lifecycle management of NI-DAQ-related tasks.

actions.description: 在线程中运行并等待已连接任务的执行流程。
actions.description_en: Run the thread and wait on the execution flow of the connected task.

actions.description: 关闭等待线程及其关联任务流程。
actions.description_en: Close the wait thread and its associated task flow.
